title: Benchmarks and metrics for face reconstruction accuracy

queue.claim: The FaceScape benchmark (Zhu et al., TPAMI) scores Chamfer distance, complete rate and mean normal error, binned by yaw and focal length; FaceScape has about 938 subjects × 20 expressions, mostly East Asian, and is research-only by application
queue.query: FaceScape benchmark single-view 3D face reconstruction Chamfer distance complete rate mean normal error focal length yaw

queue.claim: Florence/MICC protocol: ground truth cropped to about 95 mm around the nose tip, point-to-plane error after ICP, with 2018-era methods at about 1.5–2 mm; Stirling/ESRC FG2018 has about 2,000 test images of about 130 subjects
queue.query: MICC Florence 95 mm nose tip point-to-plane error Genova 2018 unsupervised 3D morphable model regression
